newsitem.title: CHINA: China looks for record summer grain harvest in 97.
newsitem.headline: China looks for record summer grain harvest in 97.

text.p: China has almost completed winter grain sowing and expects to reap a record 111.5 million tonnes to 112.5 million tonnes of summer grain in 1997, the official Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.
Farmers had planted almost 45.2 million hectares during winter sowing, the agency said.
The 1996 summer grain harvest hit a record 110 million tonnes, with the early rice harvest reaching 44 million tonnes, it said.
This year's successful winter planting had laid a strong foundation for a good summer grain harvest next year, it quoted an official of the Ministry of Agriculture as saying.
Supplies of farming materials such as chemical fertilisers and pesticides were sufficient, Xinhua quoted the official as saying but gave no details.
